1	# PROGRAM.md — the live research program
2	
3	This is the single state document of the continuous research loop.
4	Every cycle reads it first and updates it last. Keep it honest, keep
5	it current, keep it short — history goes to `archive/`, results go to
6	`experiments/` and `novel/`.
7	
8	## Goal
9	
10	An O(polylog) algorithm computing the n-th prime p(n) (equivalently
11	π(x)) exactly. Target: p(10^100) in < 1 s, 100% accurate.
12	
13	**Honest position:** every known computation route is blocked — 730+
14	approaches catalogued in `status/CLOSED_PATHS.md`, four obstruction
15	theorems, the information-theoretic barrier (~√x zeta-zero phases,
16	GUE-random, behind the last ~50% of digits). The goal may require
17	mathematics that does not exist. The deliverable of each cycle is
18	honest progress: working algorithms/protocols, new structural facts
19	with measurements, precisely-closed questions with mechanisms,
20	adjacent-problem wins. Never a faked breakthrough.
21	
22	## ACTIVE LINE — the verification program (started S491, 2026-06-13)
23	
24	Computation of π(x) is blocked at √x; *verification* is not. Built and
25	measured (all unconditionally sound, all with cheating-prover tests):
26	
27	| protocol | verifies | verifier | status |
28	|---|---|---|---|
29	| wheel sum-check | Φ(x, polylog wheel) | polylog | done |
30	| Lucy base | exact π(x) | Õ(x/log x) | done — π(2²⁰−1) verified |
31	| Lucy + delegated wiring | exact π(x) | **Õ(√x)** | done — crossover p≈130 measured |
32	| compressed-prover mult-trace (step 1) | batched `Σ_d eq(ρ,d)S̃(⌊X/(dp)⌋)` | polylog `O(m·Lv)` | done — trace-certified quotient, 6 cheat classes rejected |
33	| compressed Lucy layer (step 2) | one large-side layer over the √x state | polylog + O(nb·p) wiring | done — affine/trace dispatch, 5 cheat classes, outputs = true MLEs |
34	| compressed two-sided chain (step 3) | **exact π(x) over the √x state, all K layers** | Õ(√x) (waff O(nb·p) undelegated) | done — π(x)=sieve at n≤16; 9+3 cheat classes incl. self-consistent liar |
35	| compressed chain + delegated wiring (step 4) | same, **both wirings delegated** | **cleanly Õ(√x)**, O(nb·log p)/layer, no p-linear term | done — π(x)=sieve at n≤16; 13 cheat classes incl. 4 delegation-specific liars |
36	| structured chain prover (step 5) | same, **prover Õ(x)** not Õ(x^{3/2}) | unchanged Õ(√x) | done — bit-identical transcript; prover/chain-layer O(p²)→O(p), ratio→44× @p=1021 |

44	### Open items (priority order)

46	1. **Compressed prover** — prover Õ(x) instead of Õ(x^{3/2}); the gate

48	   value-addressed (division-by-constant wiring); large side
49	   d-addressed; the cross map u = ⌊x/(dp)⌋ (variable×variable, the

51	   **Step 1 DONE (S492):**

61	   trace) and leaf-opening stand-ins documented in the results file.

72	   nb=bits(V) bits of the certified u_e (so omega/S_small are 2^nb≈√x even

78	   wiring, gate is a BAND `[p²≤v≤V]` not a bare comparator — the planned

92	   changes); `verify_waff_value` folds the `[e≤ecut]` comparator AS-IS via an

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.py — S491 continuation: the delegated-wiring upgrade of the exact-pi(x) interactive proof. The base protocol (lucy_dp_verification.py) has the verifier evaluate the division-wiring MLE W~(r_v, r_u) = MLE of [u = floor(v/p)] by a p-state automaton DP: O(n*p) per layer, total O~(x/log x) over all layers (and the width-dichotomy measurement proved 2p+1 is TIGHT for explicit automatons). This script removes that bottleneck by DELEGATING the automaton DP itself to the prover: The DP is a chain v_{j+1} = M_j v_j of n matrix-vector products over the 2^l-embedded state space (l = ceil(log2 p)). Each M_j is known to the verifier symbolically: its nonzero pattern is the AFFINE relation s' = 2 s + a - b p, (a, b) in {0,1}^2, weighted by the outer challenge weights for bit a of v and quotient bit b of u. The agreed low-degree extension is M~_j(sig', sig) = LT~(sig') * LT~(sig) * R~_j(sig', sig), R~_j = sum_{a,b} wv_j(a) wu_j(b) * AFF~_{a-bp}(sig, sig'), and the verifier evaluates AFF~_c (the MLE of [y = 2x + c] on l-bit integers) in O(l) by a WIDTH-4 carry automaton — no p-dependence. Each chain layer is reduced by a 2l-variable sum-check with the eq-selector inserted (standard GKR form, needed because the layer identity only extends multilinearly through Boolean points). Verifier wiring cost per Lucy layer: O(n * log p) instead of O(n * p). Total exact-pi(x) verifier: sum_{p <= sqrt x} O(n log p) = O~(sqrt x). Soundness remains unconditional. Trade-off (measured): communication rises (the chain transcripts), prover gains O(n p^2)-ish extra work — both still O~(sqrt x)-compatible overall. What would falsify: honest delegated run rejected or accepted with a count differing from the sieve; cheating prover (false wiring claim, or corrupted DP propagated consistently) accepted above the soundness bound; wiring-check verifier time failing to flatten in p (must scale ~log p while the automaton baseline scales ~p). Usage: python3 lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.py --selftest python3 lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.py --n 16 --cheat-trials 10 python3 lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.py --wiring-bench """ import argparse import time import numpy as np from lucy_dp_verification import (Q, lagrange_eval, eq_table, eq_point, mle_eval, s0_closed_form, ge_const_eval, w_div_eval, sumcheck, prover_tables, direct_pi) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # verifier-side O(l) primitives # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- def lt_const_eval(rho, M, l): """MLE of [s < M] on l-bit s at point rho. O(l). When M >= 2^l the predicate is constantly true (the p = 2, l = 1 boundary case).""" if M >= (1 << l): return 1 return (Q + 1 - ge_const_eval(rho, M, l)) % Q def aff_rel_eval(rho_x, rho_y, c, l): """MLE of the affine relation [y = 2x + c] over l-bit integers x, y, at field points rho_x, rho_y (bits MSB-first). Width-4 carry automaton (carry, prev-x-bit), processed LSB-first. O(l). c >= 0: y = 2x + c. At LSB-position i: t = x_{i-1} + c_i + carry; requires y_i = t & 1; accept iff final x_prev = carry = 0. c < 0: y + d = 2x, d = -c > 0. t = y_i + d_i + carry; requires (2x)_i = x_{i-1} = t & 1; accept iff final carry == x_prev. """ xb = list(reversed([int(v) % Q for v in rho_x])) yb = list(reversed([int(v) % Q for v in rho_y])) # process enough positions to exhaust the constant and the shift; # bits of x, y beyond position l-1 are virtual zeros L = max(l, abs(c).bit_length()) + 1 st = {(0, 0): 1} # state: (carry, xprev) -> weight for i in range(L): wx = [(Q + 1 - xb[i]) % Q, xb[i]] if i < l else [1, 0] wy = [(Q + 1 - yb[i]) % Q, yb[i]] if i < l else [1, 0] new = {} for (carry, xprev), w in st.items(): if w == 0: continue if c >= 0: ci = (c >> i) & 1 t = xprev + ci + carry ybit, carry2 = t & 1, t >> 1 if wy[ybit] == 0: continue for xi in (0, 1): if wx[xi] == 0: continue key = (carry2, xi) new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + w * wy[ybit] % Q * wx[xi]) % Q else: d = -c di = (d >> i) & 1 for yi in (0, 1): if wy[yi] == 0: continue t = yi + di + carry if (t & 1) != xprev: continue carry2 = t >> 1 for xi in (0, 1): if wx[xi] == 0: continue key = (carry2, xi) new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + w * wy[yi] % Q * wx[xi]) % Q st = new # all bit positions through L-1 are consumed (x_{L-1} = 0 virtual), # so the equation holds iff no carry remains total = 0 for (carry, xprev), w in st.items(): if carry == 0: total = (total + w) % Q return total def r_tilde_eval(rho_in, rho_out, p, l, wv, wu): """Agreed extension R~_j(rho_out, rho_in) = sum_{a,b} wv[a] wu[b] AFF~_{a - b p}(x=rho_in, y=rho_out). O(l).""" tot = 0 for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): tot = (tot + wv[a] * wu[b] % Q * aff_rel_eval(rho_in, rho_out, a - b * p, l)) % Q return tot # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # inner protocol: delegated evaluation of W~(r_v, r_u) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- def bit_weights(r): r = int(r) % Q return [(Q + 1 - r) % Q, r] def inner_chain_vectors(r_v, r_u, p, l, n): """Honest prover: chain v_0..v_n over the 2^l-embedded state space. Support is kept inside the valid states [0, p) — transitions into junk states [p, 2^l) must be excluded so the layer identity v_{j+1}(s') = LT(s') * sum_s R(s', s) LT(s) v_j(s) holds on the WHOLE Boolean cube (the agreed extension kills junk via LT).""" dim = 1 << l vs = [np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.uint64)] vs[0][0] = 1 for j in range(n): wv, wu = bit_weights(r_v[j]), bit_weights(r_u[j]) v = vs[-1] nv = np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.uint64) for s in range(p): if v[s] == 0: continue for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): y = 2 * s + a - b * p if 0 <= y < p: nv[y] = (nv[y] + int(v[s]) * wv[a] % Q * wu[b]) % Q vs.append(nv) return vs def inner_r_table(p, l, wv, wu): """Prover table of R~_j on the Boolean (sig', sig) cube, index = (sig' << l) | sig.""" dim = 1 << l Rt = np.zeros(dim * dim, dtype=np.uint64) for s in range(dim): for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): y = 2 * s + a - b * p if 0 <= y < dim: Rt[(y << l) | s] = (Rt[(y << l) | s] + wv[a] * wu[b]) % Q return Rt # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # STRUCTURED chain-layer reduction (S496): O(2^l)=O(p) prover, NOT O(p^2) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # # The dense backward sweep materializes five 2^{2l}-size tables per chain # layer (np.repeat/np.tile/inner_r_table) and runs a 2l-variable degree-5 # sum-check over them -> O(p^2) per chain layer -> Sum_p n p^2 ~ O~(x^{3/2}), # reintroducing the x^{3/2} the compressed DP removed. But the summand # F(sig',sig) = E(sig') P(sig') R_j(sig',sig) L(sig) v_j(sig) # factors: E,P depend only on sig'; L,v depend only on sig; R_j is the # SPARSE width-4 affine operator (4 nonzeros per column sig, via # sig'=2sig+a-bp) and v_j has support <= p. Splitting the 2l-variable # sum-check at the sig'/sig boundary lets BOTH phases run over O(p)-size # tables while producing the IDENTICAL transcript (same round polynomials, # challenges, final claim, scal['V']): # # phase 1 (bind sig' = y): product E(y) P(y) G(y), where # G(y) = Sum_sig R_j(y,sig) L(sig) v_j(sig) is the exact # multilinear y-table of the folded sig-sum -- built in O(p) # because each sig

> 1 row = (tb[:h] * xc + tb[h:] * xf) % Q prod = row if prod is None else (prod * row) % Q tot = (tot + (coef % Q) * int(prod.sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)) % Q evals.append(tot) rec.append(list(evals)) if (evals[0] + evals[1]) % Q != c: return False, rs, None, None r = int(rng.integers(0, Q)) rs.append(r) c = lagrange_eval(evals, r) rc = (Q + 1 - r) % Q for nm in tables: tb = tables[nm] h = len(tb) >> 1 tables[nm] = (tb[:h] * rc + tb[h:] * r) % Q scalars = {nm: int(tables[nm][0]) for nm in tables} return True, rs, c, scalars def chain_layer_reduce_structured(claim, vj, rho, lt_tab, p, l, wv, wu, rng, stats, rec=None): """One backward-sweep chain layer in O(2^l)=O(p) prover work, producing the SAME sum-check transcript as the dense product-of-5-tables reduction. Returns (ok, rr, final, {'V': v~_j(rho_in)}). rec, if given, receives each round's eval list (so a test can assert round-poly equality with the dense reduction). See the block comment above for the factorization.""" dim = 1 << l sc = (lambda *a: _sumcheck_rec(*a, rec)) if rec is not None else sumcheck # ---- phase 1: bind sig'; tables E(y), P(y), G(y) over the y-cube ---- t0 = time.perf_counter() E_y = eq_table(rho) # eq~(rho, y) P_y = lt_tab.copy() # [y < p] G_y = np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.uint64) # G(y)=Sum_w R_j(y,w) L(w) v_j(w) wbeg = vj[:p].astype(np.uint64) # L(w)=1 for w=p wcol = np.arange(p) for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): term = wv[a] * wu[b] % Q y0 = 2 * wcol + a - b * p m = (y0 >= 0) & (y0 < dim) np.add.at(G_y, y0[m], _modmul_arr(wbeg[m], term)) G_y %= Q stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 ok1, rs1, c1, sc1 = sc(claim, {"E": E_y, "P": P_y, "G": G_y}, [(1, ["E", "P", "G"])], 5, rng) if not ok1: return False, None, None, None rho_out = rs1 # ---- phase 2: bind sig; tables (kappa R*(w)), L(w), v_j(w) over w ---- t0 = time.perf_counter() eqo = eq_table(rho_out) # eq~(rho_out, .) on the y-cube kappa = sc1["E"] * sc1["P"] % Q # E(rho_out) P(rho_out) Rstar = np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.uint64) # R*(w) = R_j(rho_out, w) wall = np.arange(dim) for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): term = wv[a] * wu[b] % Q y0 = 2 * wall + a - b * p m = (y0 >= 0) & (y0 < dim) Rstar[m] = (Rstar[m] + _modmul_arr(eqo[y0[m]], term)) % Q Rstar = _modmul_arr(Rstar, kappa) L_w = lt_tab.copy() V_w = vj.copy() stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 ok2, rs2, c2, sc2 = sc(c1, {"R": Rstar, "L": L_w, "V": V_w}, [(1, ["R", "L", "V"])], 5, rng) if not ok2: return False, None, None, None return True, rs1 + rs2, c2, {"V": sc2["V"]} def _dense_chain_evals(claim, vj, rho, lt_tab, p, l, wv, wu, rng, rec): """Reference: the dense product-of-5-tables backward-sweep reduction, recording round polynomials (test only). Mirrors inner_verify_div's loop body.""" dim = 1 << l EQb = np.repeat(eq_table(rho), dim) LTo = np.repeat(lt_tab, dim) Rt = inner_r_table(p, l, wv, wu) LTi = np.tile(lt_tab, dim) Vb = np.tile(vj, dim) return _sumcheck_rec(claim, {"EQ": EQb, "LTo": LTo, "R": Rt, "LTi": LTi, "V": Vb}, [(1, ["EQ", "LTo", "R", "LTi", "V"])], 5, rng, rec) def inner_verify_div(claim, r_v, r_u, p, n, rng, stats, accept_rem=None, lie=False, structured=False): """Verify, by GKR over the long-division automaton chain, the value of a division-relation wiring MLE at (r_v=dividend bits, r_u=quotient bits). accept_rem=None -> claim = W~(r_v, r_u), W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] (the division wiring: accept summed over ALL remainders). accept_rem=m -> claim = D~(r_v, r_u), D(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p) AND v mod p = m] (accept only when the final remainder is exactly m). The affine-image wiring e'=p*e+(p-1) is the m=p-1 case with v<-e', u<-e. Only the ACCEPT weighting of sum-check #0 depends on accept_rem; the backward chain sweep (which uses LT~ to mask junk states >= p in the AGREED EXTENSION, unrelated to acceptance) is identical either way. Verifier cost O(n*l), l=ceil(log2 p). Returns ok. structured=False (default): the backward sweep builds dense 2^{2l}-size tables -> O(n*p^2) PROVER per call (the demo's Õ(x^{3/2}) chain-prover bottleneck). structured=True: chain_layer_reduce_structured runs the same reduction in O(n*p) prover with a bit-identical transcript -- the verifier checks and rng draws are unchanged, so honest/cheat outcomes and all downstream protocols are byte-for-byte the same. sum-check #0 is already O(p) and is left as-is.""" l = max(1, (p - 1).bit_length()) dim = 1 << l t0 = time.perf_counter() vs = inner_chain_vectors(r_v, r_u, p, l, n) if lie: # prover corrupts the chain consistently from the middle vs[n // 2] = vs[n // 2].copy() vs[n // 2][0] = (int(vs[n // 2][0]) + 1) % Q for j in range(n // 2, n): wv, wu = bit_weights(r_v[j]), bit_weights(r_u[j]) nv = np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.uint64) for s in range(p): for a in (0, 1): for b in (0, 1): y = 2 * s + a - b * p if 0 <= y < p: nv[y] = (nv[y] + int(vs[j][s]) * wv[a] % Q * wu[b]) % Q vs[j + 1] = nv lt_tab = (np.arange(dim) < p).astype(np.uint64) # junk-state mask if accept_rem is None: acc_tab = lt_tab.copy() # [sigma < p] else: acc_tab = (np.arange(dim) == accept_rem).astype(np.uint64) acc_bits = [(accept_rem >> (l - 1 - i)) & 1 for i in range(l)] stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 # sum-check #0: claim = sum_sig ACC(sig) * v_n(sig) ok, r0, final0, scal0 = sumcheck(claim, {"ACC": acc_tab, "V": vs[n].copy()}, [(1, ["ACC", "V"])], 2, rng) stats["comm"] += l * 3 if not ok: return False t0 = time.perf_counter() acc_mle = (lt_const_eval(r0, p, l) if accept_rem is None else eq_point(acc_bits, r0)) if final0 != acc_mle * scal0["V"] % Q: stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 return False stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 rho, claim = r0, scal0["V"] # claim about v~_n at rho for j in range(n - 1, -1, -1): wv, wu = bit_weights(r_v[j]), bit_weights(r_u[j]) # claim = sum_{sig',sig} eq(rho,sig') LT(sig') R_j(sig',sig) # LT(sig) v~_j(sig) if structured: ok, rr, final, scal = chain_layer_reduce_structured( claim, vs[j], rho, lt_tab, p, l, wv, wu, rng, stats) else: t0 = time.perf_counter() eqt = eq_table(rho) EQb = np.repeat(eqt, dim) LTo = np.repeat(lt_tab, dim) Rt = inner_r_table(p, l, wv, wu) LTi = np.tile(lt_tab, dim) Vb = np.tile(vs[j], dim) stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 ok, rr, final, scal = sumcheck(claim, {"EQ": EQb, "LTo": LTo, "R": Rt, "LTi": LTi, "V": Vb}, [(1, ["EQ", "LTo", "R", "LTi", "V"])], 5, rng) stats["comm"] += 2 * l * 6 if not ok: return False rho_out, rho_in = rr[:l], rr[l:] t0 = time.perf_counter() expect = (eq_point(rho, rho_out) * lt_const_eval(rho_out, p, l) % Q * r_tilde_eval(rho_in, rho_out, p, l, wv, wu) % Q * lt_const_eval(rho_in, p, l) % Q * scal["V"]) % Q okf = final == expect stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 if not okf: return False rho, claim = rho_in, scal["V"] # base: v~_0 = MLE of e_0 t0 = time.perf_counter() base = 1 for ri in rho: base = base * ((Q + 1 - int(ri)) % Q) % Q okb = claim == base stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 return okb def inner_verify_W(claimW, r_v, r_u, p, n, rng, stats, lie=False, structured=False): """Division wiring W~(r_v, r_u) = MLE of [u=floor(v/p)]: accept over all remainders. Thin wrapper over inner_verify_div(accept_rem=None).""" return inner_verify_div(claimW, r_v, r_u, p, n, rng, stats, accept_rem=None, lie=lie, structured=structured) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # outer protocol with delegated wiring # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- def verify_layer_delegated(i, p, n, z, claim, S_prev_field, rng, stats, lie_inner=False, structured=False): """Same as lucy_dp_verification.verify_layer, but the phase-B final wiring value is verified by the inner GKR chain instead of the verifier's O(n*p) automaton DP.""" N = 1 << n v = np.arange(N, dtype=np.int64) c_i = (i - 1) % Q t0 = time.perf_counter() EQ = eq_table(z) Sf = S_prev_field.copy() Bf = (v >= p * p).astype(np.uint64) Gf = S_prev_field[v // p] stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (c_i, ["EQ", "B"])] okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(claim, {"EQ": EQ, "S": Sf, "B": Bf, "G": Gf}, termsA, 3, rng) if not okA: return False, None, None s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"] t0 = time.perf_counter() eqv = eq_point(z, r_v) bv = ge_const_eval(r_v, p * p, n) ok = (finalA % Q) == eqv * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - c_i) % Q)) % Q) % Q stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 if not ok: return False, None, None t0 = time.perf_counter() Wt = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.uint64) np.add.at(Wt, v // p, eq_table(r_v)) Wt %= Q stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_field.copy()}, [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng) if not okB: return False, None, None s2 = scalB["S"] # prover claims the wiring value (computed by its own automaton DP); # verifier checks the algebra, then verifies the claim via the inner # chain at O(n log p) instead of evaluating it at O(n p) t0 = time.perf_counter() wv_claim = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, n) if lie_inner: wv_claim = (wv_claim + 1) % Q stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 t0 = time.perf_counter() ok = (finalB % Q) == wv_claim * s2 % Q stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 if not ok: return False, None, None if not inner_verify_W(wv_claim, r_v, r_u, p, n, rng, stats, structured=structured): return False, None, None # line batching s1@r_v, s2@r_u t0 = time.perf_counter() hs = [] for t in range(n + 1): tf = t % Q gpt = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q for a, b in zip(r_v, r_u)] hs.append(mle_eval(S_prev_field, gpt)) stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 t0 = time.perf_counter() if hs[0] != s1 or hs[1] != s2: stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 return False, None, None tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q)) new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar) tf = tstar % Q new_z = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q for a, b in zip(r_v, r_u)] stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 stats["comm"] += (4 * n) + (3 * n) + (n + 1) + 3 return True, new_z, new_claim def run_protocol_delegated(n, rng, corrupt_layer=None, lie_inner_at=None, structured=False): x = (1 << n) - 1 primes = [p for p in range(2, int(x ** 0.5) + 1) if all(p % d for d in range(2, int(p ** 0.5) + 1))] K = len(primes) S = prover_tables(n, primes) if corrupt_layer is not None: i = corrupt_layer S[i] = S[i].copy() S[i][x] += 1 v = np.arange(1 << n, dtype=np.int64) for j in range(i + 1, K + 1): p = primes[j - 1] b = v >= p * p S[j] = S[j - 1] - b * (S[j - 1][v // p] - (j - 1)) claimed_pi = int(S[K][x]) Sfield = [(s % Q).astype(np.uint64) for s in S] stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0} z = [(x >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)] claim = claimed_pi % Q for i in range(K, 0, -1): ok, z, claim = verify_layer_delegated( i, primes[i - 1], n, z, claim, Sfield[i - 1], rng, stats, lie_inner=(lie_inner_at == i), structured=structured) if not ok: return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats) t0 = time.perf_counter() ok = s0_closed_form(z) == claim % Q stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0 return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats) # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # tests # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- def selftest(): rng = np.random.default_rng(0) # 1. affine relation MLE vs brute force, exhaustive over small l and # constants exceeding the l-bit range (the p=2 regression case) for l in (1, 2, 3, 4): for c in range(-(1 << (l + 1)), 3): for x in range(1 << l): for y in range(1 << l): bx = [(x >> (l - 1 - i)) & 1 for i in range(l)] by = [(y >> (l - 1 - i)) & 1 for i in range(l)] want = 1 if y == 2 * x + c else 0 got = aff_rel_eval(bx, by, c, l) assert got == want, (l, c, x, y, got) # 2. 204	                wgt = w * wu[epb] % Q * wv[qb] % Q          # eb := qb (forced)
205	                key = (rem2, cmp2)
206	                new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + wgt) % Q
207	        st = new
208	    return sum(w for (rem, cmp), w in st.items()
209	               if rem == p - 1 and cmp in (0, 2)) % Q       # e <= ecut

212	def verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
213	                      lie_chain=False):
214	    """Prove the affine-wiring scalar
215	        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) eq(r_u,(e+1)p-1)
216	    with an O(nb log p) verifier that NEVER divides -- the delegated drop-in
217	    for the O(nb*p) waff_eval automaton.  Decomposition:
218	      waffv = sum_e EQ(r_v,e) * C(e) * Phi(e),  C(e)=[e<=ecut],
219	              Phi(e) = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1) = the pure affine-image relation.
220	    An inner sum-check over the e-cube folds the comparator C (its MLE is the
221	    O(nb) le_eval -- the 3-state comparator KEPT AS-IS) and the eq(r_v,.),
222	    leaving a single claim Phi~(r_e) = D~(r_e, r_u) for the affine-image
223	    relation D(e,e')=[e'=p*e+(p-1)].  That claim is delegated to the SAME
224	    carry-chain template (lucy_dp_delegated_wiring.inner_verify_div) with the
225	    dividend = e' (point r_u), the quotient = e (point r_e), and acceptance
226	    restricted to final remainder == p-1.  Returns ok."""
227	    Dml = 1 << nb
228	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
229	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
230	    eqru = eq_table(r_u)
231	    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
232	    img = (arange + 1) * p - 1                  # image of each e under the map
233	    vmask = img < Dml
234	    Phi = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)        # Phi[e] = eq(r_u, (e+1)p-1)
235	    Phi[arange[vmask]] = eqru[img[vmask]]
236	    Cind = (arange <= ecut).astype(np.uint64)   # [e <= ecut]
237	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
238	
239	    # inner sum-check (deg 3): waffv = sum_e EQrv(e) Cind(e) Phi(e)
240	    okI, r_e, finalI, scalI = sumcheck(waffv,
241	                                       {"EQ": eqrv.copy(), "C": Cind.copy(),
242	                                        "PHI": Phi.copy()},
243	                                       [(1, ["EQ", "C", "PHI"])], 3, rng)
244	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
245	    if not okI:
246	        return False
247	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
248	    phi_claim = scalI["PHI"]
249	    ok = (finalI % Q) == (eq_point(r_v, r_e) * le_eval(r_e, ecut, nb) % Q
250	                          * phi_claim) % Q
251	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
252	    if not ok:
253	        return False
254	    # delegate phi_claim = D~(r_e over quotient e, r_u over dividend e'),
255	    # D(e',e)=[e=floor(e'/p) and e' mod p = p-1]  <=>  e'=p*e+(p-1).
256	    return inner_verify_div(phi_claim, r_u, r_e, p, nb, rng, stats,
257	                            accept_rem=p - 1, lie=lie_chain)

264	def verify_affine_region(S_large, r_v, claimed, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
265	                         cheat=None, delegate=False):
266	    """g1_aff = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) S_large((e+1)p-1).  Routed by image
267	    index e': g1_aff = sum_{e'} Waff[e'] S_large(e').  The wiring scalar
268	    Waff~(r_u) = waff_eval(r_v, r_u) is either evaluated by the O(nb*p)
269	    automaton (delegate=False) or PROVEN by the O(nb*log p) inner protocol
270	    verify_waff_value (delegate=True).  cheat in
271	    {None,'waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'}.  Returns (ok, r_u, s2)."""
272	    Dml = 1 << nb
273	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
274	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
275	    Waff = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
276	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
277	        ep1 = (e + 1) * p - 1
278	        if ep1 < Dml:
279	            Waff[ep1] = (int(Waff[ep1]) + int(eqrv[e])) % Q
280	    if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge"):                     # wrong affine image
281	        bad = (p) % Dml
282	        Waff[bad] = (int(Waff[bad]) + 1) % Q
283	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
284	    okB, r_u, finalB, scal = sumcheck(claimed,
285	                                      {"W": Waff.copy(), "S": S_large.copy()},
286	                                      [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
287	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
288	    if not okB:
289	        return False, None, None
290	    s2 = scal["S"]
291	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
292	    ok_open = s2 == mle_eval(S_large, r_u)
293	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
294	    if not ok_open:
295	        return False, None, None
296	
297	    if not delegate:
298	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
299	        waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb)            # O(nb*p) automaton
300	        ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
301	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
302	        return (ok, r_u, s2) if ok else (False, None, None)
303	
304	    # delegate: prover supplies waffv (computed Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton), the
305	    # verifier binds it to finalB and PROVES it via verify_waff_value.
306	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
307	    if cheat == "waff_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
308	        waffv = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
309	    else:
310	        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
311	        e_idx = np.arange(ecut + 1, dtype=np.int64)
312	        img = (e_idx + 1) * p - 1
313	        m = img < Dml
314	        waffv = int((eqrv[e_idx[m]].astype(np.uint64)
315	                     * eqru[img[m]] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
316	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
317	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
318	    ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q
319	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
320	    if not ok:
321	        return False, None, None
322	    okw = verify_waff_value(waffv, r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
323	                            lie_chain=(cheat == "waff_chain"))
324	    return (True, r_u, s2) if okw else (False, None, None)

327	def verify_trace_region(W, S_small, r_v, claimed, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats):
328	    """g1_trace = sum_{lo<=e<=hi} eq(r_v,e) S_small(floor(x/((e+1)p))).
329	    Certify every u_e by the step-1 trace zero-test, then route the masked
330	    small-side lookup. The band mask T(e)=[lo<=e<=hi] zeroes the affine /
331	    padding columns (whose u_e exceed V) out of the routing.  The lookup is
332	    over nb-bit values (<= V), taking the LOW nb bits of the certified u_e,
333	    so omega / S_small stay sqrt x.  Returns (ok, r_B, s_B)."""
334	    if not verify_constraints(W, rng, stats):
335	        return False, None, None
336	    D, Lv = W["D"], W["Lv"]
337	    e = np.arange(D, dtype=np.int64)
338	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
339	    Tband = ((e >= lo) & (e <= hi)).astype(np.uint64)
340	    eqr = eq_table(r_v)
341	    weight = (eqr * Tband) % Q
342	    mask = (1 << nb) - 1
343	    vlow = (W["u"] & mask).astype(np.int64)                 # low nb bits of u_e
344	    omega = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
345	    np.add.at(omega, vlow, weight)                          # < D summands < Q
346	    omega %= Q
347	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
348	
349	    # B1 (deg 2, v-cube): claimed = sum_v S_small(v) omega(v)
350	    okB1, r_B, finalB1, sB1 = sumcheck(claimed,
351	                                       {"S": S_small.copy(), "W": omega.copy()},
352	                                       [(1, ["S", "W"])], 2, rng)
353	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
354	    if not okB1:
355	        return False, None, None
356	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
357	    okf = ((finalB1 % Q) == sB1["S"] * sB1["W"] % Q
358	           and sB1["S"] == mle_eval(S_small, r_B))          # opening of S_small
359	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
360	    if not okf:
361	        return False, None, None
362	
363	    # B2 (deg nb+2, e-cube): sB1[W] = sum_e eq(r_v,e) T(e) prod_k EB_k(e),
364	    #   EB_k = eq(r_B[k], Ub_{Lv-nb+k})  (the LOW nb bits of the SAME u_e).
365	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
366	    tabs = {"EQ": eq_table(r_v), "T": Tband.copy()}
367	    ebn, jidx = [], []
368	    for k in range(nb):
369	        j = Lv - nb + k
370	        jidx.append(j)
371	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
372	        Ub = W["tabs"][f"Ub{j}"].astype(np.uint64)
373	        tabs[f"EB{k}"] = (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * Ub) % Q
374	        ebn.append(f"EB{k}")
375	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
376	    okB2, r_C, finalB2, _ = sumcheck(sB1["W"], tabs,
377	                                     [(1, ["EQ", "T"] + ebn)], nb + 2, rng)
378	    stats["comm"] += (nb + 3) * nb
379	    if not okB2:
380	        return False, None, None
381	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
382	    expect = eq_point(r_v, r_C) * band_eval(r_C, lo, hi, nb) % Q
383	    for k in range(nb):
384	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
385	        ub = mle_eval(W["tabs"][f"Ub{jidx[k]}"], r_C)       # opening of Ub_j
386	        expect = expect * (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * ub) % Q
387	    ok = (finalB2 % Q) == expect
388	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
389	    return ok, r_B, sB1["S"]

396	def line_batch_pair(S, pt0, val0, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats):
397	    """Reduce val0=S~(pt0), val1=S~(pt1) to ONE claim (new_pt, new_claim) via
398	    the degree-nb line restriction h(t)=S~((1-t)pt0+t pt1). Endpoint checks
399	    anchor a false input; new_claim is closed by mle_eval (the PCS stand-in)."""
400	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
401	    hs = []
402	    for t in range(nb + 1):
403	        tf = t % Q
404	        gp = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q
405	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
406	        hs.append(mle_eval(S, gp))
407	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
408	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
409	    ok = hs[0] == val0 and hs[1] == val1
410	    tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q))
411	    new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar)
412	    new_pt = [((Q + 1 - tstar) * int(a) + tstar * int(b)) % Q
413	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
414	    ok = ok and new_claim == mle_eval(S, new_pt)            # leaf close
415	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
416	    stats["comm"] += nb + 1
417	    return new_pt, new_claim, ok

420	def batch_on_table(S, claims, nb, rng, stats):
421	    """Fold k same-table point-claims into one by sequential line restriction.
422	    claims: list of (point, value). Returns (point, value, ok)."""
423	    pt, val = claims[0]
424	    if len(claims) == 1:                                    # still anchor it
425	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
426	        ok = val == mle_eval(S, pt)
427	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
428	        return pt, val, ok
429	    ok = True
430	    for (pt1, val1) in claims[1:]:
431	        pt, val, okp = line_batch_pair(S, pt, val, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats)
432	        ok = ok and okp
433	    return pt, val, ok

447	def large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
448	                 rng, stats, cheat=None, delegate=False):
449	    """Reduce S~_i^large(z)=C to: a large point-claim (new_z,new_claim) on
450	    S_{i-1}^large (line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a small point-claim
451	    (r_B,s_B) on S_{i-1}^small (trace region). cheat in
452	    {None,'G','split','u','waff','waff_forge','waff_chain'};
453	    'wrong_C'/'delta_pi' handled by callers via C.  delegate routes the affine
454	    wiring scalar through the O(nb log p) inner protocol."""
455	    V = isqrt(x)
456	    ci = sp % Q
457	    lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
458	    Bcut = min(V - 1, x // (p * p) - 1)
459	    Dml = 1 << nb
460	
461	    # prover-committed G table over the e-cube
462	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
463	    G = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
464	    for e in range(V):
465	        ep = (e + 1) * p
466	        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
467	    if cheat == "G":
468	        G[0] = (int(G[0]) + 1) % Q
469	    Bf = (np.arange(Dml) <= Bcut).astype(np.uint64)
470	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
471	
472	    # ---- phase A ----
473	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
474	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
475	                                          "S": S_prev_large.copy(),
476	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": G.copy()},
477	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
478	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
479	    if not okA:
480	        return dict(accepted=False)
481	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
482	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
483	    bv = le_eval(r_v, Bcut, nb)
484	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
485	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
486	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
487	    if not okA2:
488	        return dict(accepted=False)
489	
490	    # ---- honest split of g1 ----
491	    eqrv_full = eq_table(r_v)
492	    g1_aff = 0
493	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
494	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])) % Q
495	    g1_trace = 0
496	    for e in range(lo, hi + 1):
497	        g1_trace = (g1_trace + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])) % Q
498	    if cheat == "split":
499	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + 1) % Q
500	        g1_trace = (g1_trace - 1) % Q
501	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
502	    ok_sum = (g1_aff + g1_trace) % Q == g1 % Q
503	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
504	    if not ok_sum:
505	        return dict(accepted=False)
506	
507	    # ---- affine region ----
508	    okAff, r_u, s2_aff = verify_affine_region(
509	        S_prev_large, r_v, g1_aff, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
510	        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("waff", "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
511	               else None),
512	        delegate=delegate)
513	    if not okAff:
514	        return dict(accepted=False)
515	
516	    # ---- trace region ----
517	    W = build_witness(x, p, nb, dstart=1)
518	    if cheat == "u":                                        # wrong quotient in trace
519	        d = max(lo, 1) % W["D"]
520	        W["tabs"]["U"] = W["tabs"]["U"].copy()
521	        W["tabs"]["U"][d] = (int(W["tabs"]["U"][d]) + 1) % Q
522	    okTr, r_B, s_B = verify_trace_region(
523	        W, S_prev_small, r_v, g1_trace, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats)
524	    if not okTr:
525	        return dict(accepted=False)
526	
527	    # ---- line-batch s1@r_v and s2_aff@r_u (both on S_prev_large) ----
528	    new_z, new_claim, okL = line_batch_pair(
529	        S_prev_large, r_v, s1, r_u, s2_aff, nb, rng, stats)
530	    if not okL:
531	        return dict(accepted=False)
532	
533	    return dict(accepted=True, s_B=s_B, r_B=r_B,
534	                new_claim=new_claim, new_z=new_z, r_v=r_v)

537	def small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z, C, rng, stats, cheat=None,
538	                 delegate=False):
539	    """Reduce S~_i^small(z)=C to TWO point-claims on S_{i-1}^small:
540	    (r_v,s1) [the v itself] and (r_u,s2) [floor(v/p)]. The wiring v->floor(v/p)
541	    stays entirely small-side (value->value): the existing division automaton.
542	    Gate B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V] is a BAND (the upper bound keeps the recurrence off
543	    the padding). cheat in {None,'small_G','small_u','small_forge',
544	    'small_chain'}; 'small_C' via C.  delegate routes the division wiring
545	    scalar W~(r_v,r_u) through the SAME carry-chain (inner_verify_div)."""
546	    V = isqrt(x)
547	    ci = sp % Q
548	    p2 = p * p
549	    Dml = 1 << nb
550	    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
551	
552	    # ---- phase A: C = sum_v eq(z,v)[S(v) - B(v)(G(v)-ci)] ----
553	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
554	    Bf = ((arange >= p2) & (arange <= V)).astype(np.uint64)     # band [p^2<=v<=V]
555	    Gf = S_prev_small[arange // p].astype(np.uint64).copy()     # G(v)=S(floor(v/p))
556	    if cheat == "small_G":
557	        gi = (p2) % Dml
558	        Gf[gi] = (int(Gf[gi]) + 1) % Q
559	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
560	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
561	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
562	                                          "S": S_prev_small.copy(),
563	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": Gf.copy()},
564	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
565	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
566	    if not okA:
567	        return dict(accepted=False)
568	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
569	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
570	    bv = band_eval(r_v, p2, V, nb)
571	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
572	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
573	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
574	    if not okA2:
575	        return dict(accepted=False)
576	
577	    # ---- phase B: g1 = sum_u W(r_v,u) S(u),  W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] ----
578	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
579	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
580	    Wt = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
581	    np.add.at(Wt, arange // p, eqrv)                        # < p summands < Q
582	    Wt %= Q
583	    if cheat in ("small_u", "small_forge"):
584	        Wt[0] = (int(Wt[0]) + 1) % Q
585	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
586	    okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_small.copy()},
587	                                       [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
588	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
589	    if not okB:
590	        return dict(accepted=False)
591	    s2 = scalB["S"]
592	
593	    if not delegate:
594	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
595	        wv = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, nb)                    # O(nb*p) automaton
596	        okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv * s2 % Q
597	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
598	        if not okB2:
599	            return dict(accepted=False)
600	        return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])
601	
602	    # delegate: prover supplies the wiring scalar (Õ(sqrt x), NO automaton),
603	    # verifier binds it to finalB then PROVES it via the carry chain.
604	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
605	    if cheat == "small_forge" and int(s2) % Q != 0:
606	        wv_claim = finalB % Q * pow(int(s2) % Q, Q - 2, Q) % Q  # forge to pass algebra
607	    else:
608	        eqru = eq_table(r_u)
609	        wv_claim = int((eqrv.astype(np.uint64)
610	                        * eqru[arange // p] % Q).sum(dtype=np.uint64) % Q)
611	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
612	    t0 = time.perf_counter()

634	    """Verify ONE large-side compressed layer (step-2 single-layer test).
635	    cheat in {None, wrong_C, G, split, u, waff, waff_forge, waff_chain}."""
636	    V = isqrt(x)

644	    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)

666	def run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, rng, cheat=None, delegate=False):
667	    """Verify ONE full two-sided layer: (large-claim, small-claim) ->
668	    (large-claim', small-claim'). Small-side claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B
669	    from the large trace + the two from the small layer) are folded to one."""
670	    V = isqrt(x)
671	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
672	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
673	    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
674	    p = primes[layer - 1]
675	    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
676	    ecut = V // p - 1
677	    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
678	    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
679	    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
680	    S_i_small = pad(sm_layers[layer], nb)
681	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
682	
683	    zL = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
684	    zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
685	    CL = mle_eval(S_i_large, zL)
686	    CS = mle_eval(S_i_small, zS)
687	    if cheat == "wrong_C":
688	        CL = (CL + 1) % Q
689	    if cheat == "small_C":
690	        CS = (CS + 1) % Q
691	
692	    lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, zL, CL,
693	                        rng, stats,
694	                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff",
695	                                                  "waff_forge", "waff_chain")
696	                               else None),
697	                        delegate=delegate)
698	    if not lres["accepted"]:
699	        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
700	    sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, zS, CS, rng, stats,
701	                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("small_G", "small_u",
702	                                                  "small_forge", "small_chain")
703	                               else None),
704	                        delegate=delegate)
705	    if not sres["accepted"]:
706	        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
707	
708	    sB = lres["s_B"]
709	    if cheat == "carry":                                    # tamper cross-side carry
710	        sB = (sB + 1) % Q
711	    small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], sB)] + sres["claims"]
712	    zS2, CS2, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims, nb, rng, stats)
713	
714	    out_ok = (okb
715	              and CS2 == mle_eval(S_prev_small, zS2)
716	              and lres["new_claim"] == mle_eval(S_prev_large, lres["new_z"]))
717	    return dict(accepted=out_ok, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut,
718	                CS2=CS2, zS2=zS2, new_claim=lres["new_claim"],
719	                new_z=lres["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
720	                S_prev_large=S_prev_large, **stats)

727	def run_chain(x, rng, cheat=None, corrupt_layer=None, delegate=False):
728	    """Chain all K layers from S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) down to S_0 (opened on
729	    both sides). cheat='delta_pi' lies about pi(x); corrupt_layer=i0 is a
730	    self-consistent liar. delegate routes BOTH wirings (small division,
731	    large affine image) through the O(nb log p) inner protocol -- the whole
732	    per-layer verifier is then O(nb log p), no p-linear automaton term.
733	    Returns dict(accepted, claimed, layers, ...)."""
734	    V = isqrt(x)
735	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
736	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
737	    K = len(primes)
738	    if corrupt_layer is not None:
739	        sm_layers, lg_layers = corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers,
740	                                                  lg_layers, x, corrupt_layer)
741	    claimed_pi = lg_layers[K][0]
742	    if cheat == "delta_pi":
743	        claimed_pi += 1
744	
745	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
746	    z_large = [0] * nb                                       # Boolean point e=0
747	    C_large = claimed_pi % Q
748	    z_small, C_small = None, None
749	
750	    def fail():
751	        return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)
752	
753	    for i in range(K, 0, -1):
754	        p = primes[i - 1]
755	        sp = sm_layers[i - 1][p - 1]
756	        ecut = V // p - 1
757	        S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[i - 1], nb)
758	        S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[i - 1], nb)
759	
760	        lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large,
761	                            z_large, C_large, rng, stats, delegate=delegate)
762	        if not lres["accepted"]:
763	            return fail()
764	        small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], lres["s_B"])]
765	        if C_small is not None:                             # skipped at i=K
766	            sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z_small, C_small,
767	                                rng, stats, delegate=delegate)
768	            if not sres["accepted"]:
769	                return fail()
770	            small_claims += sres["claims"]
771	        z_small, C_small, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims,
772	                                               nb, rng, stats)
773	        if not okb:
774	            return fail()
775	        z_large, C_large = lres["new_z"], lres["new_claim"]
776	
777	    # base: open S_0 on both sides (leaf-opening stand-in, O(sqrt x) once)
778	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
779	    S0_large = pad(lg_layers[0], nb)
780	    S0_small = pad(sm_layers[0], nb)
781	    ok = (C_large == mle_eval(S0_large, z_large)
782	          and C_small == mle_eval(S0_small, z_small))
783	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
784	    return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

791	def sieve_pi(x):
792	    s = np.ones(x + 1, dtype=bool)
793	    s[:2] = False
794	    for q in range(2, isqrt(x) + 1):
795	        if s[q]:
796	            s[q * q::q] = False
797	    return int(s.sum())
